title: Grateful Dead Live at County Coliseum on 1973-11-23

ai_review.summary: Pristine soundboard capture of a smooth 11/23/73 El Paso show with standout performances of “Row Jimmy,” “He’s Gone,” and an inspired “Eyes of the World” jam.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear, soundboard quality that most reviewers describe as pristine, despite some confusion over keyboard balance. Musically the concert is praised as relaxed yet powerful, highlighted by Jerry Garcia’s superb guitar on Row Jimmy and He’s Gone, a top‑notch Eyes of the World jam, and memorable cowboy‑song flair such as Race Is On and Bobby McGee.

ai_rating.rationale: Majority of detailed reviews rate the show 5 stars, lauding both performance and sound quality; only one low‑rating comment concerns metadata, so overall rating is high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Soundboard source noted as crisp and pristine by several reviewers; a few mention ambiguous keyboard mix (Keith vs. Brent) but no major dropouts or distortion.

standout_songs: Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as relaxed and fluid with strong vocals; second set launches rock‑hard with energetic jams and cowboy‑song flair, maintaining high momentum to the close.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for fine form on Row Jimmy and He's Gone, shredding intense solos throughout especially in The Other One.
band_member_comments.Keys: Mixed remarks – some hear Keith clearly, others claim the keys are barely audible or mistake them for Brent; overall keyboard presence is noted but debated.
